items.title: 5.6 Viscosity of liquids (liquids ki viscosity) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.6, printed page 104.

blocks.text: Viscosity samajhne ke liye ek beaker mein pani lein, use glass rod se hilayein aur kuch der chhor dein. Pani ka ghoomna thori der mein tham jata hai. Ghaur se dekhein: beaker ki deewaron ke saath wali liquid ki layer (tah) sab se pehle rukti hai aur beech (centre) wali layer sab se aakhir mein. Matlab deewar ke saath ruki hui layer apne saath lagi layer ko foran aahista karti hai; yeh aahista layer agli andar wali layer ko bhi aahista karti hai, magar kam. Yani liquid ki aahista chalne wali layer apne saath wali tez layer ko aahista karti hai. Saath saath wali layers ke darmiyan yeh ek friction (ragar) wali force hai.

blocks.title: Viscosity
blocks.text: Liquid ke flow (behne) ke khilaf is resistance (rukawat) ko viscosity kehte hain.
SI system mein viscosity ki unit kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ hai. CGS system mein is ki unit poise (P) hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Shehad (honey) aur pani dono ko ulta karein: shehad aahista behta hai kyunke us ki layers ek doosre ko zyada rokti hain; us ki viscosity zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Hilaye hue beaker mein beech (centre) ka liquid sab se der tak kyun ghoomta rehta hai?
blocks.explanation: Deewar wali layer deewar ki wajah se foran ruk jati hai; har agli andar wali layer apne bahar wali aahista layer se friction ki wajah se thori aahista hoti hai. Beech wala hissa deewar se sab se door hai, is liye us par yeh resistance sab se aakhir mein aur sab se kam pohanchti hai.

items: Viscosity: liquid ke flow ke khilaf resistance, saath wali layers ke darmiyan friction; deewar wali layer pehle rukti hai, beech wali aakhir mein.
Units: kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ (SI), poise P (CGS).
